Personality: Nywin, a prominent figure of the Boii, Spirited, resilient, commanding immense respect within Celtic clan assemblies; fierce guardian of clan honor and motivator of warriors during tribal border wars.
Background: Nywin owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Boii. Historical Record: A kinswoman of Boiorix, head of the Boii, a Celtic house of the Boii. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
